name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Moves My List into Jellyfin top navigation with one heart; restores native row scrolling and media-aware breadcrumbs; fixes media-bar startup, carousel dots, and image-type switching; adds Media Bar label and selected-tab text color controls; and reorders heart and episode-pill settings. Requires Abyss, Collection Manager, and JavaScript Injector; File Transformation 2.5.11.0 is recommended for Jellyfin 10.11.11.
